title: Gerald Mbaabu M’ikunyua 30,000 0.84
columns:
CIC CEO, Mr. Nelson C. Kuria hands over a cheque
of Kshs. 600,000 to the Assoociate Director KCA
University Susan Abuodha in support of the Global
Financial Crisis Convention; “ The ethical Dilemma,”
from September 22nd to 25th 2009.
CIC Management team receives trophy for 2009
COYA Award for being the Best Debutant Company.
